reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on the 'sluggish diffusion' concept, which is debated and not universally observed in HEAs, especially at the high end of the temperature range (up to 1923 K) where entropic stabilization may be insufficient to prevent phase separation.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and uses appropriate techniques (in situ XRD, STEM-EDS), but the falsification criterion (>10% segregation) is somewhat arbitrary and the measurement of diffusion coefficients in nanoparticles across such a wide temperature range is extremely challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the core question of stability in multi-element nanoparticles and proposes a well-defined, comparative experimental framework that would advance understanding, even if the specific mechanism is debated.
